title: Best Running & Everyday Sneakers for Indian Roads: Cushioning, Sizing & Official Store Perks
description: Indian concrete, broken footpaths, and monsoon-slick tiles punish the wrong shoes. Pick based on grip and support for your use, get sizing right in CM, and buy from trusted channels for popular models.

content_blocks.heading: Out-of-the-Box Insider Reality (What Other Sites Won't Tell You)
items: Indian roads are tough on shoes: prioritize outsole grip and durability (e.g. Continental rubber on select Adidas models) if you walk/run on wet tiles or rough asphalt.
Size in CM, not just UK: half-size mistakes are common. Measure your foot length and match the brand’s CM chart—especially for narrow performance fits.

Counterfeit risk is highest on hyped models. Buying from adidas.co.in (and other official channels) can save you from fakes and makes exchanges simpler; adiClub perks may add value on eligible purchases.

content_blocks.heading: Why treadmill comfort doesn’t always translate outdoors
paragraphs: A soft, comfy sole can feel great indoors but wear quickly or slip on monsoon-wet surfaces. For Indian daily use, think about grip, outsole durability, and support before aesthetics.

content_blocks.heading: Get the fit right the first time
paragraphs: Check each brand’s size chart in centimeters, leave a bit of toe room for running, and consider width/lockdown for your foot shape. If you’re between sizes, use the CM measurement as your anchor.

items.q: Which shoes are best for Indian monsoon roads?
items.a: Look for durable outsoles with reliable wet grip and a stable fit. Model choice matters more than brand name—check outsole material and tread suited to wet tiles/roads.

items.q: How should I choose sneaker size online in India?
items.a: Measure your foot length in centimeters and use the brand’s CM/UK size chart. For running shoes, ensure enough toe room and a secure midfoot fit.

items.q: Is Adidas better than Nike for running in India?
items.a: It depends on the model and your needs. Adidas offers strong grip options on some lines, Nike excels in responsive performance models, and ASICS is often preferred for stability/cushioning—compare specific shoes, not just brands.

items.q: How do I avoid fake sneakers?
items.a: Buy from official brand stores or authorized retailers, be cautious of unusually low prices, and check packaging, labels, and return policies.
